create_bias_noise_generator: create a BiasNoise generator to add constant bias to sensor data with optional clipping bounds
create_normal_noise_generator: create a NormalNoise generator to add Gaussian noise with configurable scale and bias to data
create_uniform_noise_generator: create a UniformNoise generator to add uniformly distributed noise between low and high bounds
create_range_noise_generator: create a RangeNoise generator to add meter-scaled Gaussian noise to lidar range sensor readings
create_twist_noise_filter: create a TwistNoise filter to add clipped Gaussian noise to linear and angular velocity actions
